id.description: Unique identifier for the audit log entry

timestamp.description: Timestamp of when the audited event occurred

tenantId.description: Identifier for the tenant associated with the event

actor.description: Details about the entity that performed the action

name.description: Name or identifier of the actor

action.description: The action that was performed (e.g., tool_invocation, agent_decision, user_login)

target.description: Details about the resource or entity that was affected by the action

type.description: Type of the target (e.g., tool, agent, document)

context.description: Additional context or details about the action

errorMessage.description: Error message if the outcome was 'failure'
